_ga.description: Registers a unique ID to generate statistical data on how the visitor uses the website.

_gid.description: Registers a unique ID to generate statistical data on how the visitor uses the website. Expires after 24 hours.

_gat.description: Used by Google Analytics to throttle request rate.

_fbp.description: Used by Facebook to deliver a series of advertisement products such as real time bidding from third party advertisers.

_fbc.description: Used by Facebook to store click IDs from ads for conversion measurement.

fr.description: Used by Facebook to deliver a series of advertisement products such as real time bidding from third party advertisers.

ide.description: Used by Google DoubleClick to register and report the website user's actions after viewing or clicking one of the advertiser's ads.

__gads.description: Used to register what ads have been displayed to the user. Used to measure effectiveness of ads.

muid.description: Used by Microsoft Bing Ads to identify a unique web browser. Cookie enables ad targeting and is linked to a unique user ID.

_clck.description: Used by Microsoft Clarity to track user interactions on the website for analytics.

_clsk.description: Used by Microsoft Clarity to store and consolidate page views of a user's single session.

_hjid.description: Sets a unique ID for the session. This allows the website to obtain data on visitor behavior for statistical purposes.

bcookie.description: Used by LinkedIn to track visitors on multiple websites, in order to present relevant advertisement based on the visitor's preferences.

lidc.description: Used by LinkedIn for routing purposes; facilitates data center selection.

usermatchhistory.description: Used to track visitors across multiple websites, in order to present relevant advertisement based on visitor preferences.

ysc.description: Registers a unique ID to keep statistics of what videos from YouTube the user has seen.

visitor_info1_live.description: Tries to estimate the user's bandwidth on pages with integrated YouTube videos.

nid.description: Registers a unique ID that identifies a returning user's device. The ID is used for targeted ads.

consent.description: Used to detect if the visitor has accepted the marketing category in the cookie banner.

__cf_bm.description: Used to identify and distinguish bots from human visitors. Part of Cloudflare's Bot Management solution.

_hjsession.description: Contains current session data. Holds cookie for the duration of the browser session.

mp_.description: Used by Mixpanel to track events and user behavior for analytics.

ajs_.description: Used by Segment.io to track visitors across web pages.

_mkto_trk.description: This cookie is set by Marketo. This allows the website to track visitor behavior for marketing purposes.

__qca.description: Collects data on visitor behaviour from multiple websites, in order to present more relevant advertisements.

intercom-.description: Used by Intercom to identify the visitor and link to a user account for live chat support.

entry.description: Used by Google Analytics 4 to persist session state.
Used by Google Analytics (Urchin) to track visitor source, session information, and campaign data.
Used by Hotjar to detect the first pageview session of a user.
Used by Stripe for fraud prevention and to remember device trust state.
Used by Google Tag Manager to control the loading of a Google Analytics tag.
Used by YouTube to store user preferences and bandwidth information.
